# `gameplay/spells/SpellElementMixer.js`

> **Source:** `engine/gameplay/spells/SpellElementMixer.js`

SpellElementMixer.js - Element Combination System Handles mixing two or more elements to create combined/hybrid elements: - Fire + Ice = Steam - Fire + Nature = Ash - Lightning + Water = Electrified - etc. Combined elements have unique visual effects and status effects.
